mission: Fulfill explicitly declared missing artifact and evidence dependencies on demand from authoritative preserved sources, then return receipts to the requesting Penta or governance gate.

integrations.PentaFactory: Requests production artifacts when a factory/release dependency is absent.
integrations.PentaVergence: Supplies preserved source material for stale-state convergence without rewriting lineage.
integrations.PentaRoute: Uses PentaFetch/PentaGet/PentaResolve semantics to locate declared sources.
integrations.PentaVault: May consume vaulted authoritative source references; never exposes secrets.
integrations.PentaSerialized: Produces immutable-style provision receipts and preserves prior lineage.
integrations.PentaHelp: Accepts missing-dependency requests and returns resolved/HOLD dispositions.
integrations.PentaRelease: Feeds resolved artifacts back into the exact blocked release gate for rerun.
